I will keep this bean plot low-cost because my land is small and I do not have much cash to risk. I saw some women nearby plant improved bean seed when they can get it, and it does better if the rains come well, so I will use improved seed if I can buy a small amount on time. I will put manure from home on the plot, but I will not buy chemical fertilizer, and I will depend on the rains instead of irrigation. I will do most of the work myself with family help, and I will not hire labor.
